Improvements: Adding NPC activities, making the world more alive by making characters actually go around their lives and do stuff
Lara now actually harvests honey from bee hives in the Slepbone Pathway map
Equipping a bow now automatically equips the first available arrows
Companions can now find loot from enemies and chest when the player kills or finds a chest, and they can decide if the new equipment is better than their current one, essentially switching equipment
Redesigned the enemy HUD bars to be more attractive

Fixed some lock on issues where the lock on would not work because they ray cast from player to enemy was using a longer distance than the actual distance between them, causing the raycast to wrongly detect and consider objects behind the enemy as blocking the view. the lock on should be much snappier now and less prone to errors
Improved lock on camera by making the switching targets more smooth, it should be less janky now when switching targets
Added slight damp to camera collisions so it has a smoother effect when colliding with objects
Fixed issue where we couldn't pickup items if they were too close to each other
Status effects and active effects now sit above the player and AI to make it more obvious to the player
Enemies now show the status effects they are inflicted with below their healthbar
Additions: Added NPC / Enemy Name to the top of the healthbar
Added Dorrim, a new blacksmith npc in Slepbone Beach
Added new books to Cacildes Home
Added shield poking attacks - you can now attack behind shields
It is now possible to upgrade shields, armors and also spells at a blacksmith forge
Added a new secret area in Slepbone Beach map where you can find a new character which can help with blacksmith and boss weapons
Fixes: Adding UI indicator for current left hand attack, you can now see the damage of the right weapon and left weapon in the UI
Fixed bug where hitting an enemy when he was stunned would not apply critical damage
